consequence.statement: The Cilium Operator's Kubernetes client now uses a default rate limit of 100 QPS/200 Burst, which may differ from previous agent-level defaults; operators can now independently configure these rates using the new --operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst flags.

original.statement: The Cilium Operator component introduces two new CLI flags (--operator-k8s-client-qps and --operator-k8s-client-burst) to allow separate configuration of Kubernetes client rate limits, with a new default of 100 QPS/200 Burst.

decision.reason: [ev-fa8f791f1c11] says the default rate limit for Cilium Operator K8s clients has been increased to 100 QPS/200 Burst, and that it can be configured separately with new flags or Helm values. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so a changed default that keeps working is behavior-change (review). The proposed statement matches the evidence. The evidence doesn't settle the severity either way, so medium is acceptable.
